content:
sophia_r: NovaTrade presales: need EU-only processing for tenant data during POC. APAC can be a cold standby but no persisted copies outside EU. BYO-KMS mandatory. They want delta pricing for dedicated vs hosted + egress breakdown. Any red flags?
mike_t: Sounds ok. We can enforce tenant_affinity + region pinning to eu-west and configure failover to ap-southeast in ephemeral mode (no KV persist). BYO-KMS: requires network path to their KMS or customer-provided endpoint; expect ~50-100ms extra per request for key unwrap.
nina_v: Ops to-do: get customer CIDRs, confirm acceptable subprocessors (they initially reject non-EU subprocs), prep firewall rules, and create smoke tests that assert no outbound IPs outside EU during normal flow. Also need test keys from customer for BYO-KMS.
infra_bot: Automated: current subproc inventory link (internal): https://redwood.internal/subprocs/latest. We can generate CSV with country locations + compliance level on request.
sophia_r: Timeline: 4-week POC. They want SLA note and canary rollout (5% -> 100%). Pricing: mike/nina any ballpark?
mike_t: Ballpark: dedicated reserved pool ~+25% versus hosted for same throughput due to reserved capacity + standby. BYO-KMS one-time onboarding fee (engineering + security review) TBD. Egress: we'll break out EU-internal vs cross-border.
legal_ops: Looping in legal: if they exclude non-EU subprocessors entirely that's a contract risk; we can offer per-subproc attestation for allowed vendors.
sophia_r: Action items: mike_t: tech matrix + canary plan by tomorrow noon; nina_v: ops runbook + CIDR template by EOD; infra_bot: subproc CSV export when requested; legal_ops: review subproc exclusion language. I'll update customer and schedule prep call. Thanks everyone!
